children.name: udisk
children.note: Writable file storage used for custom apps and other files. The partition reserves 10 MiB; the captured FAT16 format provides 10,426,368 bytes of file-data capacity. Clean-stock free space has not been measured. Installed apps and their usage are excluded from this reference.
children.verification: Writable filesystem verified; captured FAT16 format verified; clean-stock free space not measured
children.source: Verified device ACPT partition table / stock contents not supplied

evidence.Device capture: The captured reservation contains non-FF bytes. Non-FF byte counts are not a measure of active data. Observed FAT16 format: 512-byte sectors, 1024-byte clusters, two identical FAT copies. 59,392 bytes of format overhead leave 10,426,368 bytes of file-data capacity. These describe the captured format, not verified factory formatting or available space.
evidence.Driver and format: ACPT file ID 40 matches PARTITION_FILE_ID_UDISK in the Actions SDK partition header. Filesystem geometry comes from the captured boot sector and allocation-table equality; installed files and their free-space counts are excluded.
evidence.Verification limits: Factory contents and subsequent use are not documented by this device observation.

children.name: NAND management
children.note: Capacity managed internally by the flash translation layer: mapping tables, update-log blocks and the block allocation pool.
children.verification: Capacity and roles verified; stock allocation unknown
children.source: Chip geometry + driver trace + live metadata; no physical content dump

evidence.Driver and format: 1024 physical blocks minus 984 logical blocks = 40 blocks (5 MiB). Physical-page reader and mapping/log/pool handling were traced.
evidence.Device capture: Two live RAM metadata captures accounted for 8 update-log blocks, 31 allocation-pool blocks and 1 zone-table block. Two physical blocks exchanged roles; these counts are observations, not a factory baseline.
evidence.Verification limits: Raw physical contents, full OOB, per-block health and factory role assignments remain unverified. Pool membership does not imply erased pages.
